_comment: Facts with no code constant. gen-site-facts.ts fails if an anchor is missing from its source: whoever changes the code must re-state the fact here (T-0542).

mpp.value: refund owed, sent automatically in a weekly batch
mpp.anchor: refunds are paid automatically by the
mpp.ruling: REFUND-WALLET-1026 ruling-1 (escrow-finalize.stage.ts header); paid by the refund payout job (0553)

x402.anchor: no settle call, the signed authorization is never submitted

legal_index_hash_reproducible.value: every sha256 in /legal/index.json is reproducible from the bytes at its source_url; scheduled versions at /legal/index.next.json

categories_call.value: GET /api/v1/categories and MCP tool apibase.categories (free): category, tool count and price min/median/max, same object on both

tool_list_params.value: GET /api/tools and GET /api/v1/tools accept view=compact|full, limit, cursor and category; with any of them the response carries total and truncated, and view=compact items hold id, name, category, price_usd and summary

tool_list_rate_limit.value: GET /api/tools and GET /api/v1/tools allow 120 requests per minute per address; the 121st in a minute returns 429 rate_limited

mcp_list_view_lean.value: https://apibase.pro/mcp?tools=lean lists only the discovery tools (apibase.discover, apibase.categories, apibase.describe) and apibase.call; every tool stays callable by name; /mcp and /mcp?tools=all list everything

mcp_list_view_shop.value: https://apibase.pro/mcp?tools=shop lists the discovery tools plus every shop.* tool; it is the MCP URL of the seller agent guide

apibase_call.value: apibase.call (MCP name apibase.tools.call) calls one tool by id; the request is rewritten into the direct call of that tool before payment code reads it, so it is priced, challenged and settled as that call; the wrapper is free
